name: Aethelgard Theme
description:
🏰 Aethelgard Theme - Dark Gothic & RPG Minecraft Web Theme

Aethelgard Theme is a premium Crafter theme for your Minecraft server that goes beyond ordinary designs, built with a dark gothic RPG architecture and gold-plated, aged details. With dark obsidian backgrounds, custom Cinzel medieval typography and immersive animations, it gives your players an unforgettable realm experience.

✨ Key Features

  • ⚔️ Gothic & RPG design architecture: dark obsidian and stone-textured backgrounds, gold-leaf aged plates, sharp RPG buttons and captivating atmospheric effects.
  • 🚶‍♂️ Live 3D character podium: custom podiums that show the latest warriors to join the server and the most generous lords as full-body 3D Minecraft skin models.
  • 📜 Dynamic scrolling announcement bar (marquee): delivers the announcements you add in the admin panel to your players on a sleek, seamless, endlessly looping bar.
  • 💬 Live Discord & server statistics: integrated widgets that automatically pull the live online player count of your server and the live member count of your Discord server.
  • 🛍️ Legendary treasures store: discount badges, server/category filtering, quick add to cart and a smooth checkout experience.
  • 🛡️ Player profile & profile wall: player statistics, a personal chest inventory (/chest), and comments and replies on the profile wall.
  • 🎫 24/7 support & forum system: an advanced support system where your players can easily open tickets, and a categorized community forum.
  • ⚙️ 100% compatible with the Crafter admin panel (settings_schema.json): all colors, logos, scrolling announcements, hero titles, footer menus, slider contents and page modules can be customized from your admin panel with one click.
  • ⚡ High performance & full mobile support: a responsive code structure that works flawlessly on all mobile devices and tablets, and NProgress page transition effects.

📄 All Supported Pages and Templates

  • Home (/): hero banner, live statistics, 3D warrior podium, featured slider, scrolling announcements, store showcase and quick guide.
  • Store & products (/store): product listing filtered by server and category, and product detail pages.
  • Cart (/cart): coupons, paying with balance and an order summary.
  • Warrior chest (/chest): view earned items and activate/use them in game with one click.
  • Profile & settings (/profile & /profile/settings): player wall, inventory, password and email updates.
  • Login & sign-up (/auth): stylish gothic-themed login, sign-up, forgot password and password reset screens.
  • Forum (/forum): opening topics, categories, detailed topic and message reply flow.
  • Support center (/support): ticket creation, ticket history and a staff reply panel.
  • News & announcements (/posts): server updates, announcements and news details.
  • Vote (/vote): list of vote sites and voting redirects.
  • Records & punishments (/punishments): ban, mute and warning lists.
  • Balance & item gifting (/gift): a panel to send balance or chest items to other players.
  • Redeem a code (/redeem): a screen to activate gift/promotion codes.
  • Help & legal (/help, /legal): server guide, rules, privacy policy and terms of service.

Give your server a majestic air with Aethelgard Theme and take player engagement to the top!
